svg.title: OUR HOME - Interchangeable Welcome Home Sign
svg.desc: Size 9.00 x 3.00 in (228.6 x 76.2 mm). 1 unit = 1 mm. RED = cut (all closed paths, text converted to outlines). BLUE = optional score/engrave border (do not cut through). Personal and small-batch physical sales only - do not share or resell this file.
